title: Masmark part ways with estellyy., sign HikariiFloofie
author: BPL Staff
body:
[Masmark](#/team/masmark) have made a change to their active roster, releasing AWPer [estellyy.](#/player/estellyy) and signing free-agent rifler [HikariiFloofie](#/player/hikariifloofie) in her place. The move takes effect immediately.

For much of the past year [Masmark](#/team/masmark) ran a double-AWP setup, with [estellyy.](#/player/estellyy) sharing the sniper role alongside [Xyrolizea](#/player/xyrolizea). That left the side a little light on pure rifle firepower, and this switch is aimed squarely at fixing it. [HikariiFloofie](#/player/hikariifloofie) arrives off strong recent form, posting a 64% win rate and a 1.12 K/D, and she steps straight into the rifle line next to [urnisa_](#/player/urnisa) and [kn](#/player/kn).

The change also keeps the roster tightly knit around a shared language and region. With in-game leader [XueHuaVT](#/player/xuehuavt) calling the shots and [Xyrolizea](#/player/xyrolizea) now the team's sole AWPer, [Masmark](#/team/masmark) field an all-SEA five that should communicate cleanly under pressure.

[estellyy.](#/player/estellyy) departs as a free agent after a long run with the club stretching back to 2023, a tenure that took in multiple Audax Esse Invitational campaigns. She leaves as one of Masmark's most familiar faces, and there is plenty of interest in where she lands next.

The timing is deliberate. The swap arrives midway through Bot Pro Cup 2026, giving [HikariiFloofie](#/player/hikariifloofie) a live stage to settle in and the team a chance to see whether a single-AWP, rifle-heavy look can push them up the standings.

title: Team Singapore crowned BPL Nations Cup 2026 champions
author: BPL Staff
body:
Team Singapore are the champions of the [BPL Nations Cup 2026](#/tournament/bpl-nations-cup-2026), sweeping through the bracket and dropping just a single map on their way to the title.

The run began in the Round of 16 with a clean 2-0 win over Team Vietnam. Singapore never looked troubled, setting the tone for what would become one of the most convincing title runs the Nations Cup has seen.

The Quarterfinals brought another 2-0, this time against a strong Team Taiwan side. [caturteer](#/player/caturteer) and [obvMX](#/player/obvmx) led the fragging while [twentyrosie](#/player/twentyrosie) and [Aranionja](#/player/aranionja) provided the supporting firepower, and [Dirfun](#/player/dirfun) anchored the sniper role down the stretch.

In the Semifinals, Singapore met Team Indonesia, the eventual third-place finishers, and once again closed it out 2-0. The result booked their place in the final without dropping a map across the first three rounds.

The Final was the only real test. Team Korea, who had battled their way to the championship match, managed to take a map off Singapore, but it was not enough. Singapore steadied themselves and closed out a 3-1 victory to lift the trophy.

Across four rounds Singapore went 2-0, 2-0, 2-0 and 3-1, conceding just one map in the entire tournament. It is a statement result for [caturteer](#/player/caturteer), [Aranionja](#/player/aranionja), [obvMX](#/player/obvmx), [twentyrosie](#/player/twentyrosie) and [Dirfun](#/player/dirfun), and it cements Singapore right at the top of the region.
